|errata_history=This is the AI (alternate image) printing; the image is the Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB8-D-jangofetttheassassinai-pre.gif]], undated), which prints the current title •Jango Fett, The Assassin and the current text (the base card's PC-E2). No AI printing under the old title •The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett is known: the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet has no AI slip, the archived PC website card lists (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) have no row for an AI card, and the Master List (27 April 2013) has no AI slip either<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. So this printing has one version. The base card's versions are [[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett (V)]] (original), [[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Jango Fett, The Assassin (V)]] (PC-E2, current).
* '''AI''' (this page): Players Committee AI card image, undated: “[Pilot] 3. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to Lost Pile instead. While piloted by two Fetts (unless your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table), Slave I is immune to attrition < 9.” The lore changed to “Trade Federation. Scout.”
